cases.subject: Space toggles play from the chart
cases.given: focus on the chart region, status ready, a playable chart, no modifiers, event not prevented
cases.expected: exactly one play-run intent with a trusted-keyboard gesture receipt

cases.subject: Space pauses while playing
cases.given: status playing, focus outside any control

cases.subject: Shift+Space plays the section
cases.given: a selection inside a section, status ready, playable chart
cases.expected: exactly one section-play intent (controller arms the section loop and plays atomically) with a trusted-keyboard gesture

cases.subject: prevented default is honored
cases.expected: no intent; the guard ignores the event

cases.subject: modifier held
cases.given: Space with Ctrl, Meta, or Alt held

cases.subject: edit fields are sacred
cases.given: Space targeted at an INPUT, TEXTAREA, or SELECT (including the tempo field)
cases.expected: no intent; the field receives the character or selection change

cases.subject: contenteditable is sacred
cases.given: Space targeted at an isContentEditable node

cases.subject: buttons and links keep their activation
cases.given: Space targeted inside a button, a[href], or [role=button]
cases.expected: no global intent; the focused control activates natively

cases.subject: slider focus keeps arrow keys local
cases.expected: Arrow/ Page/ Home/ End keys move the slider only; the global Space handler is unaffected but Space on the slider does not toggle play

cases.subject: arrow step
cases.given: slider focused during a paused run at beat 3
cases.expected: ArrowRight dispatches one seek to exact beat 4; ArrowLeft to beat 2

cases.subject: bar step
cases.given: slider focused, plan meter 4/4, paused at beat 6
cases.expected: Shift+ArrowRight seeks to exact beat 10; Shift+ArrowLeft to beat 2

cases.subject: page step and bounds
cases.given: slider focused at beat 5 of a 16-beat plan
cases.expected: PageUp seeks to beat 9; PageDown to beat 1; Home to beat 0; End to beat 16

cases.subject: keys clamp at plan bounds
cases.given: slider focused at beat 1 of a 16-beat plan
cases.expected: PageDown clamps to beat 0; no seek-out-of-range intent is ever dispatched

cases.subject: display sweep never feeds a seek
cases.given: a slider key press while the rAF sweep shows an interpolated position ahead of the committed playhead
cases.expected: the seek computes from the committed accepted playhead, never the interpolated display value
